title: Main labor market indicators by Variables, Year and Gender

valueTexts: Rate of the economically inactive population as a share of the working age population (15-64 years)
Employment to population ratio - employment rate (15-64 years old)
Youth employment-to-population ratio - youth employment rate (15-24 years old)
Participation of NEET youth in the youth population (15-24 years)
Participation of non-sustainable employment in total employment (15-64 years)
